prompt: A backyard is $20 \times 30$ ft. The rectangular pool is $5 \times 10$ ft. Find the **non-pool** area.
hint: The pool sits inside the backyard. The part that is not pool is what remains after you take the pool away.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Picture a tiny yard that is $3 \times 3$ with a $1 \times 1$ pool. The yard without the pool is $9 - 1 = 8$. Do the same with the big numbers.
The pool sits inside the backyard. The part that is not pool is what remains after you take the pool away.
The whole backyard is $20 \times 30 = 600$ and the pool is $5 \times 10 = 50$. Subtract the pool from the backyard.
$600 - 50 = 550$, so the non-pool area is $550$ square feet.

explanation: Find the area of the whole backyard: $20 \times 30 = 600$ square feet.
Find the area taken up by the pool: $5 \times 10 = 50$ square feet.
The pool is inside the yard, so subtract it to leave the rest: $600 - 50 = 550$.
The non-pool area of the backyard is $550$ square feet.
